summary: One behavior in one named subsystem: extend the WI-02b spine renderer in place with the presentation half of the section 52 techniques (partial anatomy A, parallax crossing B, foreground occluder C, sonar-scale readout of the WI-03d1 signal E, no center framing G, plus the very-long-body extension under section 34 budgets), all reading simulation state only, proven by the tier's presentation-only browser spot-checks (one large, one colossal) and the section 34 performance guard. The techniques are not independently shippable features: the acceptance read (AC-roster-large presentation half: the colossal reads through its techniques, never a clean full-body view, never a centered boss intro) is the combined presentation, so this is one independently testable behavior, not five. Boundaries are explicit and consistent with siblings: simulation rules and headless evidence stay in WI-03d1 (which names this item for the presentation half), production placement and the roster-wide FINAL PROOFS stay in WI-03d3, spectacle beats are ST-04, ending content ST-05, and the definitive 60 FPS check stays ST-07. Criteria AC-roster-large and AC-roster-tests are carried verbatim from the WI-03d story; with WI-03d1 and WI-03d3 the union covers all three parent criteria, and final proof ownership is named (presentation half here, roster-wide audit in WI-03d3). depends_on is only WI-03d1, which is correct: the passes read the simulation state WI-03d1 exposes and the spot-checks exercise WI-03d1's organisms; no dependency on an ancestor or descendant. The fresh-session handoff (story plan, request sections 13/33/34/46/52/68/70/74, WI-03d1 landed state, WI-01b ids, design_private/) lets a fresh implementer proceed without reconstructing the task. No findings requiring split or revise.
